claim: Coval & Shumway (2001): on S&P 500 index options, zero-beta ATM straddles lost about 3% per week on average, implying a priced volatility factor; calls' expected returns rise with strike, puts' fall below risk-free.
quote: zero‐beta, at‐the‐money straddle positions produce average losses of approximately three percent per week.
title: Expected Option Returns (J. Finance)

claim: Beckmeyer-Branger-Gayda retail 0DTE SPX study (about 2 years, to 2023, net of transaction costs): retail lost over $70M total; average daily losses $184,000, rising to $358,000 after daily expirations began 2022-05-16.
quote: While average daily retail losses were $184,000 for the entire sample, since May 16, 2022 (the introduction of a daily expiration calendar), daily retail losses grew to $358,000.
title: Retail Investors are in Love with Same Day Options (summary by the authors, WealthManagement)

claim: Same study: about 60% of daily retail 0DTE losses came from transaction costs, and buyers of options paid the variance risk premium, with negative expected returns before expenses.
quote: buyers of options pay the variance risk premium and have negative expected returns even before expenses
title: Retail Investors are in Love with Same Day Options

claim: Vilkov, 0DTE Trading Rules (SPX options, Sept 2016 to 11 Jan 2024, static daily rules held to expiry): some trades such as buying deep in-the-money calls look profitable at the median, but return distributions are so wide that most average returns are not distinguishable from zero. Via secondary summary; fills and costs not stated there.
quote: Some trades look profitable at the median, including buying deep in-the-money calls and selling out-of-the-money calls and puts
title: 0DTE options: tiny edge, huge distribution (Hull Tactical summary of Vilkov)

claim: Vilkov (per Hull Tactical summary): much of 0DTE strategy P&L is explained by realized skewness of the underlying index return, so conditional rules need a view on the shape of the move.
quote: much of the P&L of these strategies can be explained by realized skewness in the underlying index return
title: 0DTE options: tiny edge, huge distribution

claim: ORATS (vendor, self-reported): the 2026 earnings season was unusually favorable to straddle buyers, with average straddle return of about 45% because actual moves exceeded implied; history shows straddles usually priced rich.
quote: options straddles generating an average return of about 45%, a significant shift from the previous quarters
title: ORATS earnings straddles strong season 2026
